A vibrant and open broadcast industry is a pillar of an open and democratic society. In keeping with Hon’ble Prime Minister’s vision of Digital India and Ease of Doing Business, the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting is committed to provide efficient and transparent regime for the growth and management of the Broadcast Sector. BroadcastSeva is our effort in that direction.
